content.text: Our Seekh Kebabs are minced lamb with fresh herbs and a little green chilli, flame-grilled over charcoal, two pieces for £7.95. Simple, honest grilling, just the way we like it 🙏 Come say hello this week.

sources.data: Warm, friendly and family-run. We talk to customers like regulars, even on their first visit. Short, upbeat sentences with a little East London charm. Use the customer's first name. One or two emojis at most (🔥 😋 🙏), never a wall of them. Never pushy or salesy. Always say thank you. On bad reviews: apologise sincerely, never argue, and invite them back to make it right.
Please ask our staff about allergens before you order.

recent: Our Mixed Grill Platter is a proper feast 🔥 Lamb chops, chicken tikka, seekh kebab and wings, all flame-grilled over charcoal and served with naan and salad, just £18.50. Perfect for sharing (or not, we won't judge). Pop in tonight and dig in!
This weekend: a free Mango Lassi with every Mixed Grill Platter. See you Saturday!
